items.difficulty_reason: The counted lemma is the author lemma at source lines 517-520: an omega-consistent axiomatizable theory extending Q does not prove the negation of its Godel sentence. The author proof (522-541) runs a genuine omega-inconsistency construction: assuming T proves the negation of G_T, it splits on consistency, invokes the unit's unprovability lemma in the consistent case, produces the infinite family of refutations of each numeral instance of the proof predicate from the non-derivability of G_T, and contrasts this with the existential form of the negated Godel sentence supplied by the unit's Q-equivalence, landing exactly on omega-inconsistency. Keeping the infinitude of the numeral instances and the single existential aligned is the load-bearing move.
